spec.build_notes:
TIMELINE ARCHITECTURE — one master 12s clock for every STORY element: `animation-duration:12s; animation-iteration-count:infinite;` with chapter timing expressed as percentage keyframes. Two explicit exemptions, now written into law: (1) depth-dust motes run their own independent infinite floats (12s and 6s — exact divisors of the master — with negative delays for phase spread); because they never reset against the master they are seam-safe by construction. (2) The camera is ONE independent 12s animation (see below), not per-chapter segments. Easing: house cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) for decisive moves EXCEPT the RETURN flip, which uses cubic-bezier(.5,.05,.3,1) (slow-start) to widen the invisible reset windows; linear with baked spacing for ambient curves.

DOM STRUCTURE (load-bearing — do not improvise): .stage (perspective:1100px) > .diorama (preserve-3d, ambient rotateX/rotateY) > [dust divs, ground-shadow pair, desktop bezel, FLIP CARD, flash overlay, sheen overlay, phone, cursor]. The flip card is a SIBLING of the bezel, positioned to align with the bezel's painted aperture — it is NEVER inside any overflow:hidden ancestor. All clipping lives on face-internal 2D wrappers: the site face owns its own overflow-hidden .screen div for the scroll (contains no 3D children), the code face owns its own rounded clip. Every element between .stage and the card carries preserve-3d and no overflow, filter, or opacity<1 grouping property. CTA click feedback is scale(0.97) ONLY — no translateZ inside the clipped screen.

CAMERA — one 12s keyframed curve on .diorama: rotateY = -4°·cos(2πt/12): trough (-4°) sits exactly at 0%/100%, so position AND velocity (zero) match at the seam by construction. rotateX fixed 6°. Push-in scale: 1 at 0%, holds ~1 to 35%, eases to 1.05 at 75% (9.0s, mid-REFLOW), eases back to 1 at 100% with flat tangents both ends. Chapters DESCRIBE this curve; none owns a segment.

RETURN FLIP RESET MATH: flip runs 180°→360° across 93.33%–100% (11.2–12.0s) on the slow-start bezier. Code face is front-facing only for angle>270°, which this ease crosses at ~97% of the loop; site face is front-facing only for angle<270°. Therefore: CODE-FACE resets (8 syntax bars→scaleX(0), caret off, ghost layout→0) at the 94% keyframe (angle ≈185°, code face backfacing, 3%+ margin). SITE-FACE resets (scroll→translateY(0), Stack B→opacity 0, LIVE chip→0) at the 99% keyframe (angle ≈347°, site face backfacing since ~97%). BUILD-TIME ASSERTION: generate the bezier angle-vs-time table once and assert code resets land at angle ∈ (185°,265°) and site resets at angle > 278°.

OTHER TRICKY BITS: forward flip (COMPILE) keeps house ease, faces backface-hidden, site face pre-rotated 180°; total rotation 0→180→360 so 12.0s ≡ 0.0s exactly. Compile flash and sheen are NON-ROTATING camera-facing sibling overlays at the card's silhouette, translateZ(1px) — never children of the rotating card (a glow riding the card is edge-on exactly when needed). Sheen animates translateX+opacity inside the master clock, sweep at 58.3%–66.7%. Phone bob is folded into the phone's single 12s keyframe set as small translateY oscillation between 78% and 92% — no nested wrapper, no non-integer sub-loop. Cursor shadow is a second offset path baked into the same SVG at rgba(70,66,60,.3) — no filter on an animated element. Mono text (SHIP/BUILD label, LIVE chip) sits in fixed width/height boxes; font-display:swap with ui-monospace fallback; the two woff2 files preloaded; no glyph-based dashes anywhere (all bars are divs).

PROGRESSIVE ENHANCEMENT (CSS-first): the stylesheet's DEFAULT state is the designed tableau (static transforms, zero animations declared running). The ~30-line JS adds .animate, which zeroes the tableau transforms and starts the master clock; IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.25) toggles paused/running via .playing; will-change added by JS to exactly three movers (flip card, phone, cursor) on first intersection, removed after 5s off-screen. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .stage *{animation:none !important} } holds the tableau in pure CSS. If JS never runs, every visitor sees the finished tableau, not an empty dark frame.

CRITIQUE RESOLUTIONS (every high/medium):
• [cred-H1 + perf-H3, preserve-3d broken by overflow ancestors] RESOLVED: flip card re-homed as sibling of the bezel, all clipping moved onto face-internal 2D wrappers, CTA translateZ dip replaced with scale-only; DOM chain spelled out above so the build cannot regress.
• [cred-H2 + perf-H1, 94% reset visible] RESOLVED: resets split by face (94% code / 99% site), RETURN flip re-eased to slow-start cubic-bezier(.5,.05,.3,1) to widen both windows, angle-vs-time assertion required at build time.
• [perf-H2, edge-glow edge-on at flip midpoint] RESOLVED: flash and sheen detached into non-rotating camera-facing overlays; flash keyframed 23%–27.5% (2.76–3.30s) around the forward flip's 90° midpoint at ~2.95s.
• [perf-H4 + cred-M camera seam contradiction] RESOLVED: camera decoupled into one 12s cosine with trough and zero velocity at 0%/100%; per-chapter camera prose now quotes values of that single curve; the RETURN whip (+4→-4 in 1s) is gone.
• [clarity-H1, loop lands on process] RESOLVED: chapters rebalanced — WRITE 0–2.2, COMPILE 2.2–4.2, ALIVE 4.2–8.0, REFLOW 8.0–11.2, RETURN 11.2–12.0 (0.8s whip-flip). Product-visible time ≈75% of loop; phone and SHIP label stay visible until the final 0.4s.
• [clarity-H2, mobile WRITE illegible] RESOLVED: (1) mono BUILD→SHIP label kept on mobile as a 10px chip pinned inside the panel top-left; (2) the code face itself carries a faint ghost of the site layout (nav hairline + two headline bars, #f6f5f3 at 10% opacity, fading in 1.2–2.2s) — the destination is visible inside the code chapter. (The critic's placement — ghost on the bezel BEHIND the card — is unbuildable: the opaque card covers the aperture; on-face placement delivers the same read and is guaranteed visible.)
• [cred-M + clarity-M4, REFLOW simultaneous moves] RESOLVED: sequenced with causality — phone rises 8.2–9.1 arriving already populated, 0.3s held beat, desktop crossfade A→B 9.4–10.1 while the phone is static, purple dot pulses once at 10.1 as the trade completes.
• [cred-M, RETURN crams five changes] RESOLVED: stage evacuated before the flip owns the chapter — phone begins its exit fade at 11.0 (a decrescendo, completing 11.6), LIVE chip needs no separate fade (it rides the rotating site face and resets at 99%), label crossfade is a designed beat at 11.6–11.9; RETURN's one decisive move is the flip, with only the pre-authored camera curve underneath.
• [cred-M + clarity causality, ALIVE autoplay-scroll] RESOLVED: cursor enters 4.4–5.0 and rests over the content; scroll plays 5.3–6.3 under the held cursor (reads as wheel-scroll); cursor moves to CTA 6.4–6.7; click 6.8. Every motion on the site face now has a visible author. LIVE chip fade-in moved to the COMPILE settle (3.9–4.2s) where it means 'shipped', not to the click (clarity-low adopted).
• [cred-M, dust off the master clock] PARTIALLY OVERRULED with reason: independent infinite mote loops never reset at the master seam, so they cannot pop — the perf critic's low-severity note is mathematically correct and wins. Adopted anyway: 12s/6s divisor durations + negative delays for full determinism, and the false 'dust phase (12s sine)' claim is deleted from the loop copy.
• [perf-M, JS-only fallback is a dud] RESOLVED: inverted to CSS-default tableau + JS-added .animate + CSS-only prefers-reduced-motion, as specified above.
• [perf-M, SVG mote children repaint] RESOLVED: motes are four plain 2–3px border-radius divs, each its own composited layer; cursor stays SVG.
• [perf-M, node budget undercounted] RESOLVED: honest recount at ≈55/70 (15 headroom) after cutting motes 6→4, merging feature bars into two silhouette bars, deleting the stand hairline everywhere, folding the phone bob (no wrapper node), and counting the second shadow div, ghost layout, flash and sheen overlays explicitly.
• [perf-M, 3.5s phone bob drifts] RESOLVED: bob folded into the phone's 12s keyframes (78%–92% oscillation) — one animation, phase-locked, zero drift.
• [perf-M, shadow clipping at panel edge] RESOLVED: total downward shadow extent (offset+blur−spread) capped at ≤22px so nothing crosses the panel padding; the 8% safe margin is redefined to INCLUDE shadow extents; blur radii halved on mobile.
• [clarity-M3, stacks identical at 340px] RESOLVED: differentiation moved to silhouette level — Stack A is tall/editorial (hero media block, two wide bars, CTA pill), Stack B is a dense 2×2 product-tile grid with one BUY pill; the morph reads as a different KIND of product at thumbnail size.
• [lows adopted]: macOS traffic-light dots replaced with a single 24px #55524d hairline chrome segment; sheen retimed to 58.3%–66.7% and correctly labeled translateX+opacity; label restore owned as a designed crossfade (the false 'under cover of the flip' rationale deleted); cursor shadow baked as an SVG path; LIVE chip is dot-only at 5px on mobile, authored 11px on desktop with a post-perspective legibility check; font-loading plan added.

chapters.name: WRITE
chapters.action: The dark editor screen is the only lit object. Eight syntax bars type themselves in: each scaleX(0→1) from the left in 0.24s (transform-origin:left, fast segment so code lands line-by-line, not oozing), staggered 0.22s apart starting at 0.2s, with indent steps (bars 3–5 inset 12px, bar 6 inset 24px). The 2px purple caret blinks (opacity steps) at the head of the active line. From 1.2–2.2s a faint ghost of the site layout — nav hairline + two headline bars at #f6f5f3 10% opacity — fades in beneath the syntax bars: the code visibly contains a website-in-waiting. DECISIVE MOVE: at 1.9s the final bar lands and the caret gives one long deliberate blink — a held beat of stillness before the flip.
chapters.camera: perspective 1100px, origin 50% 42%. The global 12s camera curve (rotateX 6° constant; rotateY = -4°·cos(2πt/12)) carries the diorama from -4.0° at 0.0s to -1.6° at 2.2s; scale holds 1.0. Dust at translateZ(-140px) parallaxes at 0.4×.
chapters.color: Ground #f1f0ee. Editor screen: linear-gradient(150deg,#141414,#2b2a27). Syntax bars: #8b8781 and #a39f99 at 85% opacity (two-tone rhythm). Chrome strip: single 24px #55524d hairline segment (generic window chrome, no traffic lights). Ghost layout #f6f5f3 at 10%. Caret: oklch(0.62 0.19 305) — accent moment 1 of 4. Bezel hairline #dedbd6.

chapters.name: COMPILE
chapters.action: DECISIVE MOVE: the flip card performs a single 180° rotateY flip, 2.4–3.5s (1.1s, house cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)) — code face rotates away, live-site face rotates in fully composed (nav, hero media block, headline bars, CTA already laid out: it was BUILT, it doesn't assemble). At the 90° edge-on midpoint (~2.95s) a NON-ROTATING purple flash overlay at the card's silhouette blooms 0→.7→0 across 2.76–3.30s, covering the face swap like a compile spark. 3.5–3.9s: settle — overshoot to 184° easing back to 180°, ground shadow deepens 10% via the pre-painted second shadow div crossfading in. Mono label crossfades BUILD → SHIP at 3.4–3.7s. The LIVE chip (pill + pulsing dot) fades in at the screen's top-right 3.9–4.2s — the product is shipped.
chapters.camera: Global curve only: rotateY -1.6°→+0.9° across the chapter, scale 1.0 — the camera cedes all drama to the flip. Ground shadow scaleX(1→0.92→1) synced to the flip (thinner when the card is edge-on).
chapters.color: Site face: panel gradient linear-gradient(160deg,#ffffff,#eceae7); hero media block #f6f5f3 with 1px #e4e2de border; headline bars #dedbd6; CTA: ink #0d0d0d pill. Flash overlay: oklch(0.62 0.19 305) at ≤0.7 opacity — accent moment 2 of 4. LIVE chip: #f6f5f3 pill, #e4e2de border, dot #0d0d0d at 40% opacity on pulseDot.

chapters.name: ALIVE
chapters.action: The site proves someone is driving. 4.4–5.0s: cursor arrow eases in from lower-right and comes to REST over the content — the human arrives first. 5.3–6.3s: the content stack scrolls (translateY 0→-18% inside the face-internal overflow-hidden screen, 1.0s house ease) while the cursor holds position — it reads as wheel-scrolling, authored motion. 6.4–6.7s: cursor glides to the ink CTA pill. DECISIVE MOVE at 6.8s: the click — cursor scale(1→0.86→1) in 0.2s, pill dips scale(0.97), a purple ripple ring blooms off it (scale 0→1.6, opacity .5→0, 0.42s). 7.0–8.0s: the sheen overlay sweeps the site face left→right (translateX + opacity, 58.3%–66.7% of the master clock) as the product rests and breathes.
chapters.camera: Global curve: rotateY +0.9°→+2.0°; scale begins its ease off 1.0 (reaching ~1.02 by 8.0s). Cursor rides at translateZ(90px) with its shadow baked as a second SVG path offset down-right (315° light).
chapters.color: All neutrals: #f6f5f3 blocks, #dedbd6 bars, ink #0d0d0d CTA and cursor fill (1px #ffffff stroke). Ripple: oklch(0.62 0.19 305) — accent moment 3 of 4. Sheen: white at ≤8% opacity, crossing left→right with the established light.

chapters.name: REFLOW
chapters.action: One move at a time, with causality. DECISIVE MOVE 1 owns the eye first: 8.2–9.1s the phone rises from lower-left — translate3d(40px,60px,20px)→(0,0,70px), rotateY(-14°→-8°), opacity 0→1, 0.9s house ease — its screen arriving ALREADY populated with the mini service landing. 9.1–9.4s: held beat, phone static. THEN the consequence: 9.4–10.1s the desktop crossfades (opacity + 6px translateY hand-off) from the tall editorial service landing (Stack A) to the dense 2×2 storefront grid (Stack B) — two silhouettes so different they read at thumbnail size. At 10.1s the single purple status dot on the phone pulses once as the trade completes: one system, two products, both live at once. 10.3–11.0s: the pair orbits gently (phone bob folded into its master-clock keyframes, 78%–92%). At 11.0s the phone begins a quiet exit fade (decrescendo, completes 11.6s) — the review is over.
chapters.camera: Global curve: rotateY +2.0° → 0° (at 9.0s) → -3.7° by 11.2s; push-in peaks at scale 1.05 at 9.0s (75%) then begins releasing. Phone at translateZ(70px) parallaxes 1.15× vs the desktop's 1×, dust 0.4×. Max composed tilt: rotateX 6° + phone local rotateY 8° (peak 14° on entry) — under the 22° cap.
chapters.color: Phone bezel: dark surface #141414→#2b2a27, screen #f6f5f3, mini blocks #dedbd6/#a39f99 with a mini ink CTA. Stack B: four #f6f5f3 tiles (1px #e4e2de borders, radius 10px) + one ink #0d0d0d BUY pill. Status dot: oklch(0.62 0.19 305) — accent moment 4 of 4, last purple of the loop.

chapters.name: RETURN
chapters.action: The seam, played as a story beat: shipping is a cycle. DECISIVE MOVE — the only one: the card whip-flips 180°→360° across the full 0.8s on cubic-bezier(.5,.05,.3,1) (slow-start, widening the reset windows). The storefront and SHIP label linger until 11.6s — the outcome is the last thing to leave. Under the flip: phone completes its fade by 11.6s; SHIP→BUILD label crossfades 11.6–11.9s as a designed beat. Invisible resets, split by face and verified against the bezier's angle table: code-face resets (bars→scaleX(0), caret off, ghost off) at 94% (card ≈185°, code face backfacing); site-face resets (scroll→0, Stack B→0, LIVE chip→0) at 99% (card ≈347°, site face backfacing since ~97%). At 12.0s every property — card 360°≡0°, camera at its cosine trough with zero velocity, shadow, label — is bit-identical to 0.0s.
chapters.camera: Global curve closes itself: rotateY -3.7°→-4.0° (the trough, zero velocity at the seam by construction), scale eases 1.02→1.0 with a flat tangent at 100%. No camera move competes with the flip.
chapters.color: Neutrals only — no accent in this chapter. Screen returns to dark surface #141414→#2b2a27; ground #f1f0ee; label #8b8781. The purple caret does not reappear until 0.2s into the next WRITE pass.

spec.depth:
STAGE: one .stage div, perspective:1100px, perspective-origin 50% 42% (900px on mobile). All 3D children under a single .diorama group with transform-style:preserve-3d — and NO element between .stage and the flip card carries overflow (other than visible), filter, or any grouping property that forces used transform-style to flat. All clipping lives strictly inside individual faces (2D content only).

Z-LAYERS (back to front):
- L0 BACK, translateZ(-140px): 4 depth-dust divs. Parallax 0.4× of camera drift. Own infinite floats (12s/6s divisors, negative delays) — exempt from the master clock, seam-safe because they never reset.
- L1 SHADOW, translateZ(-90px): ground shadow pair — base ellipse div + pre-painted deeper twin crossfaded by opacity (no box-shadow animation).
- L2 MID-BACK, translateZ(-40px): desktop bezel with the screen aperture PAINTED as an inset — a sibling BEHIND the flip card, never its ancestor. Parallax 0.85×.
- L3 MID, translateZ(0): the flip card (wrapper preserve-3d; both faces backface-hidden; site face pre-rotated 180°) — the protagonist plane, aligned over the bezel's painted aperture.
- L3+, translateZ(1px): two NON-ROTATING camera-facing overlays at the card's silhouette — compile flash and sheen. They stay facing the viewer while the card turns through them.
- L4 FRONT, translateZ(70px): phone. Parallax 1.15×.
- L5 TOP, translateZ(90px): cursor SVG + ripple div.

ROTATION BUDGET: diorama rotateX fixed 6°; rotateY driven by one 12s cosine, -4°…+4°, trough at 0%/100% (zero seam velocity). Phone local rotateY -8° (peak -14° on entry). No composed camera+object rotation exceeds 22°; the card's 360° is a local object move, not a camera move.

LIGHT: single implied source upper-left (~315°, elevated). All shadows offset +6px x / +10px y; card box-shadow 0 24px 48px -18px rgba(70,66,60,.42), phone 0 16px 32px -14px rgba(70,66,60,.38) — but total downward extent (offset+blur−spread) capped ≤22px so no shadow crosses the panel padding and clips at the rounded corner. The panel gradient's 160° direction agrees; the sheen crosses left→right at 58.3%–66.7% — light always travels the same way.

elements.name: Stage + diorama group
elements.desc: Perspective wrapper (1100px desktop / 900px mobile) and the preserve-3d group carrying the single 12s camera animation (rotateX 6°, rotateY cosine, scale push-in). No paint of its own. 2 nodes.

elements.name: Depth-dust
elements.desc: Four plain 2–3px border-radius divs, background #a39f99 at opacity .18–.3, each on its own infinite float (12s/6s durations, negative delays for phase spread) — divs, not SVG children, so each is a cheap composited layer. The 'galaxy' read, house-broken to the warm ground. 4 nodes.

elements.name: Ground shadow pair
elements.desc: Base ellipse div (radial rgba(70,66,60,.35)→transparent, offset down-right per the 315° light, scaleX keyframed to the flip) + a pre-painted deeper twin crossfaded by opacity for the COMPILE 'landing'. 2 nodes.

elements.name: Desktop bezel
elements.desc: Bezel div: dark surface linear-gradient(150deg,#141414,#2b2a27), radius 14px, 1px #dedbd6 outer hairline, aperture painted as an inset panel. SIBLING behind the flip card — never an ancestor (preserve-3d chain stays intact). Stand hairline deleted on all breakpoints. 2 nodes.

elements.name: Flip card — code face
elements.desc: Card wrapper (preserve-3d, local rotateY 0→180→360 over the loop) + editor face (own rounded clip, backface-hidden): chrome strip #2b2a27 with one 24px #55524d hairline segment (generic chrome, not traffic lights); eight 5px syntax bars, radius 3px, widths 40–85%, alternating #8b8781/#a39f99 at 85%, 12px indent steps; 2px caret oklch(0.62 0.19 305); ghost site layout (nav hairline + two headline bars, #f6f5f3 at 10% opacity) beneath the bars. 16 nodes.

elements.name: Flip card — site face, Stack A (service landing)
elements.desc: Pre-rotated 180°, backface-hidden. Panel gradient #ffffff→#eceae7. Internal overflow-hidden .screen div (2D children only) + scroll-stack wrapper (translateY scroll) + nav hairline + one large hero media block #f6f5f3/#e4e2de + two wide bars #dedbd6/#a39f99 + ink CTA pill #0d0d0d — a TALL, EDITORIAL silhouette. 8 nodes.
elements.layer: mid / translateZ(0), scroll inside face-internal clip

elements.name: LIVE chip
elements.desc: Fixed-size #f6f5f3 pill, #e4e2de border, JetBrains Mono 11px uppercase #8b8781 (authored 11px so post-perspective size stays ≥9px) + 4px dot #0d0d0d at 40% opacity on pulseDot. Mobile: text dropped, dot enlarged to 5px — the pulse alone says live. Rides the site face; resets at the 99% site-face window. 2 nodes.
elements.layer: mid / on flip card site face

elements.name: Flip card — site face, Stack B (storefront grid)
elements.desc: Absolutely positioned over Stack A, opacity 0 until REFLOW. A DENSE 2×2 grid of four equal #f6f5f3 product tiles (1px #e4e2de, radius 10px) + one small ink BUY pill — a grid silhouette unmistakably different from Stack A's editorial one at any size. No glyph dashes; all shapes are divs. 6 nodes.

elements.name: Compile flash overlay
elements.desc: NON-ROTATING camera-facing div at the card's silhouette, translateZ(1px): 1px ring oklch(0.62 0.19 305) with soft pre-painted glow; opacity 0→.7→0 keyframed 23%–27.5% of the master clock, covering the face swap while the card is edge-on. The loop's single glow allowance. 1 node.
elements.layer: mid / translateZ(1px), does NOT ride the card

elements.name: Sheen overlay
elements.desc: Non-rotating sibling over the card silhouette; white gradient strip at ≤8% opacity animating translateX + opacity (compositor-safe) left→right at 58.3%–66.7% of the master clock — mid-ALIVE, after scroll and click settle. 1 node.

elements.name: Phone
elements.desc: Bezel div (dark surface gradient, radius 14px, 1px #dedbd6 hairline) + #f6f5f3 screen + three mini content blocks (headline #dedbd6, body #a39f99, mini ink CTA) + 3px status dot oklch(0.62 0.19 305). Entrance, bob (translateY oscillation at 78%–92%), and exit all in ONE 12s keyframe set — no wrapper node, phase-locked to the master. Opacity 0 at 0% and 100%. 6 nodes.

elements.name: Cursor + ripple
elements.desc: One SVG (~14px arrow, ink #0d0d0d fill, 1px #ffffff stroke, shadow baked as a second offset path rgba(70,66,60,.3) — no filters) + sibling ripple div, 1px ring oklch(0.62 0.19 305), scale 0→1.6 / opacity .5→0 on the click. Three keyframed translate positions, never a motion-path. 2 nodes.

elements.name: BUILD/SHIP label
elements.desc: Two stacked fixed-size JetBrains Mono 10px labels (#8b8781), crossfading BUILD→SHIP at 3.4–3.7s and SHIP→BUILD at 11.6–11.9s as designed beats. Desktop: below the diorama. Mobile: pinned INSIDE the panel top-left as a 10px chip — never dropped, it is the story's caption. 3 nodes.

spec.fallback: The stylesheet's DEFAULT state (not a JS-added mode) is the designed tableau, set with static transforms and zero running animations: diorama at rotateX(6°) rotateY(+1°) scale(1.04); flip card at 180° showing the storefront grid (Stack B) on the desktop; phone locked at translateZ(70px) rotateY(-8°) showing the mini service landing; cursor at rest beside the CTA; LIVE chip visible with a static dot; label reading SHIP; full shadow set painted. JS adds .animate to start the loop; @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) forces animation:none in pure CSS so the tableau holds with or without JS — and if JS ever fails, visitors see this finished frame, never an empty dark screen. It still sells because the frame contains the whole argument at once: code became a live product (LIVE chip + resting cursor imply interactivity) and two counter-angled devices carrying two visibly different product silhouettes — editorial landing and storefront grid — prove the range. It reads as a finished editorial illustration, not a paused video.
spec.logline: A product is born in one held breath — abstract code types itself on a dark screen, flips inside-out into a living website a visible hand actually drives, then re-flows across a floating phone from service landing to storefront grid — proving Weakends doesn't decorate templates, it ships whole products, both ways, on a loop.
spec.loop: Total 12.0s. The seam is structural: the flip card rotates 0°→180° (COMPILE) and 180°→360° (RETURN), and 360°≡0°, so the protagonist is geometrically identical at both ends. Everything else is one of: (a) the single 12s camera cosine whose trough (-4°) sits exactly at 0%/100% — position AND velocity (zero) match at the seam by construction, and the scale curve has flat tangents at both ends; (b) independent infinite mote floats (12s/6s divisors, negative delays) that never reset against the master and therefore cannot pop; (c) reset inside a face-specific backface-hidden window verified against the RETURN flip's bezier angle table — code-face resets at 94% (card ≈185°), site-face resets at 99% (card ≈347°), each with 2%+ margin from the 270° crossing at ~97%; or (d) opacity 0 at both 0% and 100% (phone, ripple, flash, sheen, caret). The SHIP→BUILD label crossfade at 11.6–11.9s is a designed beat, complete 0.1s before the seam. The outcome lingers: storefront, phone, and SHIP label remain visible until the final 0.4s, so a mid-loop entrant sees product ~75% of the cycle. Nothing visible changes value across 100%→0%.
spec.mobile: At ~340×420 (content ≈ 300×360): perspective drops to 900px and the camera cosine amplitude narrows to ±2° (the flip, click, and reflow carry the drama). Desktop frame fills 92% of content width; syntax bars thicken to 6px; ghost-layout bars thicken to 2px hairlines so the website-in-waiting still reads; Stack A keeps its full editorial silhouette, Stack B keeps the 2×2 grid — the shape-level contrast is the mobile legibility strategy. KEPT on mobile (changed from draft): the BUILD→SHIP mono label, moved inside the panel as a 10px chip pinned top-left — it costs no vertical space and captions the story for a 4-second viewer. LIVE chip drops its text; the dot enlarges to 5px and pulses. Dropped: dust mote 4 (keep 3) and the sheen sweep. Phone shrinks to 0.78×, rises to overlap more of the desktop, translateZ drops to 40px; cursor grows to 16px. Shadow blur radii halved and total downward shadow extent capped within the panel padding so no shadow clips at the rounded corner. Chapter timings unchanged — identical loop, fewer instruments. The 4:3 work-card crop uses the same keyframes: the diorama is centered with an 8% safe margin defined to INCLUDE shadow extents, so the crop never clips the phone at its orbit extreme or any shadow edge.

spec.performance: NODE BUDGET (≈55 of 70, 15 headroom — honestly counted including every wrapper): stage/diorama 2, dust 4, ground-shadow pair 2, bezel 2, flip card + code face (wrapper, face, chrome strip, chrome hairline, 8 bars, caret, 3 ghost bars) 16, site face Stack A (face, screen clip, scroll wrapper, nav, hero block, 2 bars, CTA) 8, LIVE chip 2, Stack B (container, 4 tiles, BUY pill) 6, flash overlay 1, sheen overlay 1, phone 6, cursor+ripple 2, label 3. Cuts vs draft: motes 6→4, feature bars merged, stand hairline deleted, phone bob wrapper eliminated, Stack B price rows replaced by the tile grid itself. All animation is transform (translate3d/rotate/scale) and opacity ONLY — no layout, filter, box-shadow, or background animation: the deepening shadow is the pre-painted second div crossfaded by opacity; the flash is opacity-only; the sheen is translateX+opacity; the cursor shadow is a baked SVG path, not a filter. Dust motes are divs (not SVG children) so each is reliably its own composited layer — no Safari whole-SVG repaints. WILL-CHANGE: applied by JS to exactly three elements — flip card (transform), phone (transform, opacity), cursor (transform) — added on first IntersectionObserver entry, removed if the panel leaves the viewport >5s; never in CSS. FONTS: JetBrains Mono woff2 preloaded, font-display:swap with ui-monospace fallback; every text-bearing chip/label has a fixed width/height box so a font swap can never reflow the diorama. spec.title: Born Shipping

spec.build_notes:
HUMAN DECISION (unchanged, defended): the creator is implied, never drawn — over-the-shoulder desk diorama. The mic silhouette + REC light + live waveform + screen-glow ARE the person; any CSS figure imports a face/age/gender and an illustration style the geometric system cannot match. The waveform is the honest human: this service turns a voice into a week of content. New refinement: the mic is now ~70% cropped out at the tight pose and slides INTO frame during the pullback, so the human is revealed the same moment the edit is.

MASTER ARCHITECTURE: one 12s clock; every element has ONE 12s keyframe set with byte-identical 0%/100% frames (all animation declarations live in the shared <style> via classes — never inline; inline styles carry only static paint and custom props like --i). Chapters are keyframe percentages, not chained animations. Two divisor clocks: 2.4s waveform ripple (5 cycles) and 6s sheen (2 cycles). The reveal is a COMPOUND zoom: camera scale 1.32→1.0 composed with the screen container's own scale 5.0→1.0 (both accordion-eased over the same 2.6–4.4s window), reading as one dolly.

CRITIQUE RESOLUTIONS —

CRED-H1 / PERF-H2 (waveform double-clock collision): FIXED structurally. Each bar gets a wrapper: the wrapper carries the 12s story envelope (scaleY 0.12→1→0.2→0.12, identical 0%/100%); the inner bar carries the 2.4s alternate ripple as a multiplier (scaleY 0.85↔1.0) with NEGATIVE delays (calc(var(--i) * -90ms)), so nested transforms compound and the ripple is genuinely phase-locked at the seam. Per-bar heights are static layout, so the envelope is uniform. Cost paid by dropping desktop to 7 bars (matching mobile): 7 wrappers + 7 bars = 14 nodes.

CRED-H2 + CLAR-H1 (payoff erased / landing inverted): FIXED with a full rebudget — Ch1 0–2.5s, Ch2 2.5–5.0s, Ch3 5.0–7.6s, Ch4 cascade 7.6–9.3s, Ch5 hold+reset 9.3–12.0s. The complete tableau is on screen from ~9.3s to the 11.1s fade start = 1.8s clean hold, and it contains ONE decisive move: a second growBar step on every tile (attention still climbing) at 9.6–10.3s. The last decisive move the eye sees is engagement rising; the reset dolly (11.0–12.0s) is an epilogue under the fades. Seam mechanics survive intact: fades complete at 97% (11.64s), final 0.36s is pure compound camera.

PERF-H1 (reveal geometry impossible): FIXED with the compound zoom above. Verified numerically: session bar is 56px tall in the 596×436 space; 56 × 5.0 (container) × 1.32 (camera) = 370px = 85% of frame height at the tight pose — the screen legitimately fills the frame, and the pullback reveals the whole timeline.

PERF-H3 (segments + playhead never return): FIXED. Segments 2–4 keyframe translateX back to 0 at 11.1–11.5s with accordion easing ("the timeline reloads for the next take") while attention is on the fades and dolly. Playhead: see CRED-M2 below — it is gone long before the seam, and its translateX returns to 0 at 90% while opacity is 0. All 0%/100% frames byte-identical.

CRED-M1 (mic illegible on dark screen): FIXED both ways — mic ~70% cropped out of bottom-right at the tight pose, sliding into frame during the Ch2 pullback via its 1.4× translateZ(60px) parallax (a second reveal, not a contrast bug); plus a static 1px #55524d rim path on its screen-facing edge so ink separates from the dark surface wherever they overlap.

CRED-M2 (playhead end-of-life): FIXED, improved beyond the proposed fix. Playhead fades in 5.1–5.3s at x=0, sweeps, then fades to 0 at 7.3–7.5s immediately after the sweep — the tool withdraws when the cut is done. This is cleaner than fading with the chrome AND satisfies the one-ember-at-full-strength rule during the arrival ticks. translateX returns to 0 at the 90% keyframe, invisible. Identical on mobile.

CRED-M3 + CLAR-M3 (the '—' counter reads as broken data — two critics agree it's a bug-lookalike): resolved by CUTTING the chip (clarity's fix wins over credibility's relabel — clarity over cleverness). The asymmetric bars plus the second growth pulse carry "response accruing" honestly; no dots substitute needed. Frees 1 node and removes the one artifact that could read as a failed bind. The em-dash redaction device survives in the REC chip label (see lows).

PERF-M1 (node budget over 70 once corrected): FIXED with a full audited recount at 66 (see performance field), using pseudo-elements: arrival ticks are tile ::after (−3), REC dot is segment-1 ::after (−1), REC chip dot is ::before (−1), engagement rails are ::before (−3); element list corrected to FIVE layer groups matching the depth spec; every glyph SVG counted as root + one compound path; desktop waveform reduced to 7 bars.

PERF-M2 (sheen paint-order contradiction): FIXED — sheen moved out of .stage entirely: absolute sibling of the stage on the panel, z-index above, pointer-events none, clipped by the panel's 22px radius. It no longer inherits the camera transform, which is physically correct for a surface sheen.

PERF-M3 (inline styles defeat pause/reduced): FIXED — ALL animation declarations live in the shared <style> block as classes; inline styles are static paint + custom properties only (--i consumed by animation-delay). .is-paused and .reduced therefore win normally; longhand animation-play-state/animation-name rules carry !important as belt-and-braces.

PERF-M4 (mobile non-uniform rescale): FIXED — the scale-as-a-unit trick is reserved for the 4:3 work-card crop (uniform). ≤480px ships a second absolute layout via media query (~15 override rules): mono fixed at 10px, playhead 2px, chips 20×14px, tiles 38px, anchors repositioned explicitly. No distortion, no sub-pixel text.

PERF-M5 (positive delays break first paint + phase lock): FIXED — ripple uses negative delays (true self-alignment at the seam: (12 + 0.09i) mod 2.4 = 0.09i); all master-clock staggers (chip flights, chrome fade-ins, bar steps) are baked into shifted keyframe percentages inside each element's own 12s set, so there are no delay windows and no fill-mode pops.

PERF-M6 (segment radii telegraph the cut): FIXED — segments overlap-tucked 12px under their left neighbor with descending z-index inside the clip container (container is transform-style: flat so z-index applies); radii are hidden while merged and revealed purely by the translateX nudges. Zero extra nodes.

CLAR-H2 (reads as SaaS tool, not agency): FIXED — 'AUTO' chip becomes 'MANAGED' (same mono style, zero layout change), and a static JetBrains Mono 'EVERY WEEK' label sits panel bottom-left OUTSIDE the camera transform, declaring recurring done-for-you service across every frame of the loop, including the fallback.

CLAR-M1 (mid-loop 4-second read): FIXED — Ch1 shortened to 2.5s, and at the tight pose the ruler hairline + top edge of lane 1 peek into the bottom ~8% of frame at 40% opacity, so even the close-up says "this recording is already inside an edit."

CLAR-M2 (mystery-box glyphs): FIXED — tile 1's glyph is a play-triangle inside its rounded square (universally 'video platform', owned by no one); tiles 2–3 stay abstract (oblique slash, open circle); a 'PUBLISHED' mono row label fades in above the tiles with the Ch2 chrome. One anchor + one label makes the row read 'live channels'.

LOWS ADOPTED: REC chip text is 'REC · SESSION —' (labeled redaction — overrules clarity's 'keep 01' because the honesty signature must be consistent and the cost is nil); reset dolly uses the site accordion curve cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) (Material curve banished); playhead keeps cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.3,1) as the ONE documented bespoke curve (a sweep needs symmetric in-out) — no third family may be added at build time; engagement bars vary per tile (0.40/0.70, 0.55/0.85, 0.35/0.90 → second step 0.52/0.84, 0.68/1.0, 0.48/0.96) so the tableau reads observed, not generated; accent census restated honestly as 5 objects / 6 painted marks with playhead line+cap defined as one composed object, plus the hard rule: EMBER MAY NEVER SIT AT FULL STRENGTH ON MORE THAN ONE OBJECT AT ONCE (handoffs: dot dims as playhead lights at 5.3s; playhead dies 7.5s, first tick blinks 8.5s; ticks are single blinks; dot re-arms dim at 11.4s); raster fix — REC chip authored at 1.32× inside a static counter-scale(0.7576) wrapper so its 10px mono is native-crisp at the tight pose; font plan — every mono chip gets a fixed-size box with centered text so a metric swap cannot shift geometry, and the init script gates class application on document.fonts.ready with a 1s timeout; mobile mic crop defined by feature (full shock-mount ring + ≥60% capsule always in frame, only the boom arm crops; mic may stay at 40% height if 34% would lose the ring); mobile clamps playhead and glyph strokes to 2px, ember glow to 0 0 14px @45%, remaining engagement bar to 4px.
spec.title: One Take, Seven Days
spec.logline: One take at the mic becomes a week of published content: the camera pulls back from a live recording to reveal the edit already underway — a playhead slices the session into clips that fly to the platforms, and the loop holds on the week's attention climbing before it breathes back in for the next take.

chapters.name: The Session
chapters.action: Open tight on the dark screen (the session bar magnified 6.6× by the compound zoom). Decisive move: the REC dot (segment-1 ::after) wakes 0.25→1 with two pulseDot pulses, and the 7 waveform wrappers rise scaleY 0.12→1 staggered via shifted keyframe percentages while the inner bars run their 2.4s ripple multiplier (0.85↔1.0, negative delays -90ms×i). 'REC · SESSION —' chip fades in at 0.6s inside its counter-scale wrapper. Mic silhouette is ~70% cropped out bottom-right, holding its 12s ambient float (translateY ±3px). The ruler hairline and lane-1 top edge peek into the bottom ~8% of frame at 40% opacity — the close-up already says 'inside an edit'. Static 'EVERY WEEK' label sits bottom-left outside the camera, always on.
chapters.camera: Stage perspective 1100px, origin 50% 42%. Tight pose: camera scale(1.32) translateY(3%) rotateX(10deg) rotateY(-7deg) COMPOSED with screen container at scale(5.0) centered — bar height 56px × 5.0 × 1.32 = 370px ≈ 85% of the 436px frame (verified). Ambient micro-drift only (±0.3deg rotateY across 12s).
chapters.color: Ground #f1f0ee at edges; screen linear-gradient(150deg,#141414,#2b2a27); waveform bars #a39f99 @85%; mic #0d0d0d with static 1px #55524d rim on its screen-facing edge; chip text #8b8781; chrome sliver #dedbd6/#e4e2de @40%. ACCENT: ember oklch(0.62 0.19 40) on the REC dot only — the single lit point.

chapters.name: The Reveal
chapters.action: Decisive move: the compound dolly. The recording is revealed as one clip in an editing timeline — screen container eases 5.0→1.0 into its lane-1 slot while the camera pulls 1.32→1.0, both over 2.6–4.4s with the accordion curve, reading as one physical move. Timeline chrome (lane 2, ruler to full opacity, 'MANAGED' chip), the three platform tiles, and the 'PUBLISHED' row label fade in 3.0–4.6s, staggered via keyframe percentages 120ms apart. The waveform keeps rippling inside the now-small bar — proof it is the same object. The mic slides INTO frame via its 1.4× parallax: the over-the-shoulder read arrives with the reveal. REC chip HUD fades out 2.6–3.6s; the tiny ember dot on the bar stays lit.
chapters.camera: One move, 2.6–4.4s: camera scale 1.32→1.0, translateY 3%→0, rotateX 10deg→12deg, rotateY -7deg held; screen container scale 5.0→1.0 + translate to lane slot, same window, same cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1). The rotateX increase on pullback sells camera height — a dolly, not a zoom.
chapters.color: Panel gradient linear-gradient(160deg,#ffffff,#eceae7) becomes dominant; lanes #f6f5f3 with 1px #e4e2de; ruler #dedbd6; 'MANAGED' and 'PUBLISHED' in #8b8781 JetBrains Mono; tiles #ffffff faces, glyphs stroked #55524d (one play-triangle-in-square, one oblique slash, one open circle). Ember: still ONLY the tiny REC dot.

chapters.name: The Cut
chapters.action: Decisive move: the playhead fades in over 0.2s at x=0 (5.1–5.3s) as the REC dot dims to 0.25 — accent handoff, recording over. It sweeps translateX 0→536px over 5.3–7.3s (bespoke cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.3,1), fast middle, soft ends). As it crosses the three tuck points (~5.9/6.4/6.9s), segments 2/3/4 nudge right +8/16/24px (accordion curve, 0.42s spans) — the overlap-tucked radii are revealed and one session visibly becomes four clips. The waveform envelope drops to scaleY(0.2) at ~5.5s. At 7.3–7.5s the playhead fades to 0: the cut is done, the tool withdraws (its translateX returns to 0 at the 90% keyframe, invisible).
chapters.camera: Camera holds the wide pose (scale 1.0, rotateX 12deg, rotateY -7deg), ambient drift only. Stillness is deliberate — the playhead is the only fast object and inherits all attention.
chapters.color: Same field as Ch2. Ember hands off: playhead (line + triangular cap, one composed object) in oklch(0.62 0.19 40) with static pre-rendered glow (box-shadow 0 0 12px @35%); the REC dot is dim before the playhead reaches full strength — never two at once. Clip faces stay #141414→#2b2a27, 10px radii at the new cut edges.

chapters.name: The Cascade
chapters.action: Decisive move: three clip chips (28×18px, #f6f5f3, 10px radius, 1px #e4e2de) rise off segments 2–4 and fly to the platform tiles — nested-transform arcs (wrapper translateX, child translateY, different easings), launches staggered 120ms via keyframe percentages, 0.9s flights, arrivals 8.5/8.62/8.74s. On each arrival: the tile's 3px ember ::after tick blinks ONCE, and its two engagement bars growBar to their first step, 80ms apart, transform-origin left, 0.42s — asymmetric per tile: 0.40/0.70, 0.55/0.85, 0.35/0.90. All growth lands by ~9.3s. No camera motion, no fades — the cascade owns the chapter.
chapters.camera: Wide pose held, ambient drift only.
chapters.color: Tiles #ffffff with 1px #e4e2de and warm shadow 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(70,66,60,.35); glyph strokes #55524d 1.5px; engagement fills #a39f99 on ::before rails of #f6f5f3. Ember: the three arrival ticks, each a single blink, sequential — never simultaneous with each other at full strength (120ms+ apart) and the playhead is already gone.

chapters.name: The Held Week & Reset
chapters.action: THE HOLD: the complete tableau — four clips, three live tiles, grown bars, MANAGED/PUBLISHED/EVERY WEEK labels — stands untouched from 9.3s. One decisive move inside it: at 9.6–10.3s every tile's bars take a second growBar step (0.52/0.84, 0.68/1.0, 0.48/0.96, staggered 120ms) — attention still climbing. Clean hold to 11.1s: 1.8s of landed payoff, the longest stable image in the loop. THE SEAM: fades begin 11.1s (tiles, bars, chips, chrome, PUBLISHED — staggered, ALL complete by 11.64s = 97%); segments 2–4 translateX back to 0 at 11.1–11.5s under cover of the fades (the timeline reloads); waveform envelope returns to 0.12 by 11.6s; REC dot returns to its dim 0.25 at 11.4s.
chapters.camera: Reset dolly 11.0–12.0s: camera 1.0→1.32, translateY 0→3%, rotateX 12→10deg, AND screen container 1.0→5.0, both on the site accordion curve cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1). The push-in runs while the furniture fades, so the final 0.36s is pure camera arriving at the opening frame. 12.0s is byte-identical to 0.0s; only the phase-locked ripple (negative delays, 5 exact cycles) and ambient drift cross the seam mid-motion.
chapters.color: Unchanged field, draining back to Ch1's palette as opacities fall. Ember at the seam: only the dim REC dot. Full loop accent census: 5 objects (REC dot, composed playhead, 3 ticks), 6 painted marks, one family, never two at full strength at once.

spec.depth: Stage: inside the 22px-radius panel content area, .stage carries perspective: 1100px, perspective-origin 50% 42%; .stage, .camera, and the five layer groups are transform-style: preserve-3d. One .camera wrapper carries all global moves; the screen clip container additionally carries its own compound-zoom keyframes (scale 5.0↔1.0) and is transform-style: flat internally so segment z-index (the overlap tuck) applies. Base pose rotateX(12deg) rotateY(-7deg); excursions rotateX 10–12deg, rotateY -6.7 to -7.3deg ambient — far under the 22deg cap; max camera scale 1.32, max element scale 5.0 (screen container only). FIVE Z-LAYERS, each a real group div: BACK translateZ(-120px) desk back-plane + vignette; MID-BACK translateZ(-40px) timeline chrome, tiles, PUBLISHED label, engagement bars; MID translateZ(0) screen container/segments/waveform/playhead; MID-FRONT translateZ(30px) clip chips in flight + REC HUD chip; FRONT translateZ(60px) mic silhouette, cropped bottom-right, parallaxing ~1.4× against MID during both dollies — it slides into frame on the pullback (the second reveal) and back out on the reset. LIGHT: single implied source upper-left; every shadow offsets down-right, warm: cards 0 18px 44px -18px rgba(70,66,60,.45); tiles 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(70,66,60,.35); the screen casts a static warm glow on the desk plane (pre-rendered box-shadow, never animated). The 6s sheen runs top-left→bottom-right as a panel-level SIBLING of the stage (z-index above it, pointer-events none, clipped by the panel radius) — outside the camera transform, consistent with the same light, and correctly front-most regardless of preserve-3d paint order.

spec.mobile: At ≤480px (the 340×420 full-width column): a SECOND ABSOLUTE LAYOUT via media query (~15 override rules) — the uniform scale-as-a-unit trick is reserved for the 4:3 work-card crop, never for mobile (596×436→small is non-uniform and would drive type sub-pixel). CAMERA: flat push only — rotateY 0, rotateX clamped to 6deg, perspective 1300px, camera scale 1.18→1.0; screen container tight scale reduced to ~4.2 (deep 3D at this width reads as skew). FIXED SIZES: JetBrains Mono stays 10px in fixed-size chip boxes; playhead 2px wide with glow raised to 0 0 14px @45%; glyph strokes 2px; clip chips 20×14px; tiles 38px; the one remaining engagement bar per tile is 4px tall. DROPPED: desk back-plane, track lane 2, one engagement bar per tile. MIC: crop defined by feature, not percentage — the full shock-mount ring and ≥60% of the capsule stay in frame; only the boom arm crops; if that fails at 34% height the mic stays at 40% and the tile-row gap shrinks instead. Node count ~61 (66 minus desk, lane 2, and three bars).
spec.loop: Total 12.0s, one master clock. Seam engineered four ways: (1) every element's single 12s keyframe set has byte-identical 0%/100% frames — no handoffs exist; (2) all fades complete at 97% (11.64s) while the compound reset dolly (11.0–12.0s, accordion curve) is still moving, so the final 0.36s is pure camera arriving at the opening frame — the eye reads 'the next session is starting', never 'restart'; (3) the two independent clocks divide 12 exactly — waveform ripple 2.4s (5 cycles) with NEGATIVE delays (calc(var(--i) * -90ms)), making bar i's seam phase genuinely 0.09i·aligned, and the panel-level sheen 6s (2 cycles) — both cross the seam mid-motion with zero phase jump; (4) the two elements that cannot fade are explicitly returned under cover: segments 2–4 translateX back to 0 at 11.1–11.5s beneath the fading furniture (reads as the timeline reloading), and the playhead — already invisible since 7.5s — returns translateX to 0 at the 90% keyframe. Narrative seam: REC dims when cutting begins and re-arms dim at 11.4s; the story loops because the work loops — reinforced by the ever-present 'EVERY WEEK' label. That is the pitch.
spec.performance: NODE BUDGET (desktop, audited): structure (.stage + .camera + 5 layer groups) 7 + desk plane 1 + screen container & 4 segments 5 (REC dot is segment-1 ::after) + waveform 7 wrappers & 7 bars 14 + REC HUD chip (counter-scale wrapper + chip + text span; dot is ::before) 3 + mic SVG (root + capsule/grille/boom/ring paths + rim path) 6 + timeline chrome (2 lanes, ruler, MANAGED chip) 4 + PUBLISHED label 1 + EVERY WEEK label 1 + playhead (line + cap) 2 + clip chips (3 wrappers + 3 chips) 6 + tiles (3 × tile + svg root + one compound path; ticks are ::after) 9 + engagement bars (2 per tile; rails are ::before) 6 + sheen 1 = 66 nodes, 4 under the 70 cap. TRANSFORM/OPACITY ONLY, confirmed per element: camera and screen container (matrix), waveform wrapper scaleY envelope × inner scaleY ripple (nested transforms compound), segments translateX, playhead translateX + opacity, chips nested translateX/translateY, bars scaleX, everything else opacity; zero animated width/height/box-shadow/filter/color — all glows and shadows are static paint on elements whose opacity animates. EASING FAMILIES: exactly two — the site accordion cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) for every settle/dolly/cut, plus one documented bespoke sweep curve cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.3,1) on the playhead only. WILL-CHANGE: exactly three declarations — .camera, .screen (the compound-zoom pair), .playhead; the small staggered movers get implicit compositor layers from their running animations and must NOT be pinned. STYLE ARCHITECTURE (pause/reduced correctness): every animation declaration is a class in the shared <style> block; inline styles carry only static paint and custom props (--i for delays); .is-paused * { animation-play-state: paused !important } and the .reduced longhands therefore actually win. RASTER: the REC chip is authored at 1.32× design size inside a static counter-scale(0.7576) wrapper so its 10px mono rasterizes native-crisp at the tight pose. FONTS: both faces already loaded by the page; every mono chip has a fixed-size box with centered text so a metric swap cannot shift geometry; the init script gates class application on document.fonts.ready with a 1s timeout. JS: one small script — IntersectionObserver on the panel at threshold 0.15 toggling .is-paused on a single ancestor (animations resume in-phase because paused, not restarted), sets --i indices, and applies .reduced from matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') including on live change.
spec.fallback: prefers-reduced-motion freezes on the HELD WEEK tableau (~10.5s story moment), not on the empty screen: wide pose (camera scale 1.0, rotateX 12deg, rotateY -7deg, screen container at 1.0), session sliced into four clips with gaps open, waveform quieted in segment 1, REC dot dim, playhead absent (it has honestly withdrawn — no orphaned accent), all three tiles with their ASYMMETRIC second-step bar widths (0.52/0.84, 0.68/1.0, 0.48/0.96), 'MANAGED', 'PUBLISHED', and 'EVERY WEEK' labels visible, mic fully in frame with its rim hairline. Implemented as a .reduced class that sets every animation longhand to none (all animations are stylesheet classes, so this genuinely applies) plus these exact end-state transforms/opacities as static rules. It sells because it is the entire argument as one diagram read left-to-right: a recording, cut into clips, published to live channels, response accrued — under a label that says it happens every week. Sheen and pulses are simply absent, not replaced.

spec.build_notes:
BUILD ORDER: one shared <style> block; EVERY keyframe list is 12s so all elements share one clock — chapters are percentage bands (0–20% SIGNAL, 20–40% CONDENSE, 40–62% ADVANCE, 62–100% ASCEND), never chained short animations. Stagger = negative animation-delay only (-0.12s increments for dots), which preserves loop alignment. transform-style: preserve-3d is declared on .stage AND on every wrapper between .stage and any z-translated element (dot wrappers included); no 3D ancestor ever carries animated opacity, overflow, or filter. Panel root is overflow:hidden (declared now, not at build time) — all front-plane elements inset >=14px from panel edges, accepting shadow clipping at the rim. Pause: `.is-paused, .is-paused * { animation-play-state: paused !important; }` toggled on the panel root by the IntersectionObserver. Fonts: reuse the site's already-declared JetBrains Mono / Schibsted @font-face URLs (cache hit = no swap), font-display: swap, and every label container gets a fixed px width + fixed line-height (strings are known constants) so a late swap repaints in place with zero reflow. Alignment build step: the chart baseline must visually continue the WON column's top edge AT THE HANDOFF — compute the projected screen-space offset at exactly t=62% using the camera pose rotateX(13.2deg)/rotateY(-5.5deg); 62% is the sine's stationary point (camera velocity ≈ 0), so the alignment holds for ~1s either side of the handoff before attention transfers to the draw.

KEYFRAME STRUCTURE: .stage = one 12s camera sine, rotateX 12→13.2→12deg, rotateY -8→-5.5→-8deg, peak at 62%, cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1) segments; perspective 1100px on the static .viewport. LIVE dot = always lit: baked ±0.15 opacity oscillation (two gentle cycles across 0–100%, identical 0%/100% values) + one flare (scale 1→1.3→1, opacity to 1) at 6–9% as the surge begins. Delivery fill = scaleX(.5) at 0%, surge to .82 at 8–14.7% (0.8s, cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)), hold, opacity-swap to the static scaleX(.5) twin at 97–100%; fill and twin are both solid #55524d, border-radius 0, with radius+overflow:hidden on the TRACK so caps clip cleanly at any scaleX. Sheen = baked into a 12s block: off-screen 0–4%, one 1.2s traverse 4–14%, holds off-screen to 100% — one clock, runs once, seam exact. Dots = 2-node rigs (linear-X wrapper + eased-Y inner leaf composing the parabola); 70% opacity lives on the INNER leaf only, wrappers stay opacity:1. Each dot dips opacity briefly passing behind the funnel waypoint at its arc apex. Condensation is explicitly 3-to-1: dots 1–2 absorb into the empty NEW slot (scale→.6, fade), dot 3's arrival triggers card A's fade-in at that exact position; dots 4–6 repeat for card B — every dot accounted for. Lead cards are absolutely-positioned SIBLINGS of the board on the stage (never board children), so board paint can never flatten their 3D. Chart draw = reveal-window: overflow:hidden wrapper translates X(+w) while the inner SVG counter-translates X(-w), both strictly linear over 64.5–74.5% — no gradient ever has to match, no moving luminance seam. Endpoint dot X is strictly linear and velocity-matched to the reveal edge; all vertex easing lives in the Y channel via the same nested-transform rig as the arc dots. Halo = radial-gradient background (green→transparent 70%), NO filter:blur — pulses opacity only, the site's pulseDot grammar. Curve geometry = a STEPPED line whose three risers align horizontally to the NEW/QUALIFIED/WON columns below — the chart is the pipeline's own silhouette extruded upward.

SEAM (designed 'shift change', not concealment): 92–100% ad card eases translateZ 40→70px; 90–95% card B settle-fades in place (2px downward + opacity→0, no position change — its 0% state is opacity 0 anyway, so reset is free once invisible) and the WON status dot fades with it, reading right-to-left after the chart's exit direction; 95.5–99.5% chart + endpoint fade; 97–100% bar crossfade. The board's opacity is 1 for the entire loop and never dims. LIVE never turns off. Frame 12.000s = frame 0.000s exactly; the surge at 0.96s reads as the next cycle.

CRITIQUE RESOLUTIONS (high/medium):
[CRED-H1 un-reset board opacity + ad-card z] Board opacity is now statically 1 forever (the 40% dormant state is deleted outright — also required by PERF-H1); ad card gets an explicit 92–100% keyframe easing translateZ 40→70px on cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), staging the next cycle. Nothing is left un-reset; the seam table above enumerates every stateful element.
[CRED-H2 resets in plain sight] Cards never move at the seam — card B settle-fades IN PLACE (2px drop + opacity), position reset happens while invisible. Only ONE card remains by the seam (card A already lifted into the chart at 62%), shrinking the problem before solving it.
[CRED-H3 templated green curve] Curve redrawn as a stepped line, risers aligned to the three column positions — the pipeline's silhouette made literal, ownable geometry. Blurred bloom halo replaced with the site's pulseDot treatment: 6px green core + one soft radial-gradient ring at <=.35 opacity, opacity-only pulse.
[CRED-M1 match-cut arithmetic] Condensation ratio fixed at 3-to-1: 6 dots → 2 lead cards, each dot's disappearance choreographed (see keyframes). Lead-card count reduced 4→2 across chapters, elements, and budget consistently.
[CRED-M2 wipe/dot desync + overflow flattening] Endpoint X strictly linear, velocity-matched to the reveal edge; easing Y-only via nested transforms. Chart panel overflow:hidden declared safe because every panel child is 2D — only the panel itself holds translateZ.
[CRED-M3 chapter-3 density] Header blinks cut entirely; WON status dot + tick growBar fused into one compound arrival (dot ignites at card A's landing, bar grows 0.15s later). One cascade + one earned accent, nothing else.
[CRED-M4 alignment under a moving camera] Alignment computed at t=62% with the stated pose values — and 62% is now the sine's PEAK (stationary point), so screen-space drift near the handoff is second-order. Added as an explicit build step.
[PERF-H1 preserve-3d / opacity flattening] preserve-3d on stage + all intermediate wrappers; board opacity static 1; lead cards are stage siblings, not board children; dot opacity on the inner leaf only.
[PERF-H2 mobile overflow] Explicit mobile heights: ad card 128×140 + board 100 + chart band 100 + two 12px gaps = 364px inside the ~376px content area. See mobile field.
[PERF-H3 cover gradient mismatch] Cover div deleted; reveal-window (wrapper +w / inner SVG -w counter-translate, linear, same band) replaces it. +1 node, budgeted.
[PERF-M1 mobile chart z overflow] Mobile chart z clamped to 30px, band width 272px; panel overflow:hidden declared with >=14px insets.
[PERF-M2 seam flicker] Dormant-board dim deleted; card fade staggered/settled in place following the chart's exit; bar crossfade last (97–100%), both fills solid identical #55524d, radius on track.
[PERF-M3 font loading] Site @font-face reuse + font-display:swap + fixed-width label containers, specified above.
[PERF-M4 pause fragility] `.is-paused, .is-paused * { ... !important }` on the panel root; sheen now shares the 12s clock so it is inside scope by construction.
[CLAR-H1 label legibility] All mono labels raised to 11px; column headers bumped #8b8781→#55524d; mobile headers NEW / QUAL / WON (never single letters); mobile stage near-planar (rotateX 8deg / rotateY 0) so labels render flat.
[CLAR-H2 machine reads OFF] Base state is now RUNNING: LIVE lit and pulsing at frame one, delivery bar at scaleX(.5), chapter 1 is a delivery SURGE not a cold ignition; only one card exists at the seam and it settles under the chart's exit rhythm — no frame ever shows a dead or emptying machine.
[CLAR-H3 payoff starved] Chapters rebalanced to 2.4 / 2.4 / 2.65 / 4.55: bar grow 1.2→0.8s, dot stream 3.0→2.4s band, cascade tightened; chart fully drawn and glowing 74.5–95.5% = 2.5s+ hold, on screen 4.5s total (38% of loop).
[CLAR-M1 mobile causality break] Added the explicit connective move: card A slides down-right into the chart band's left edge and fades exactly as the wipe begins at that x — the dots→cards match-cut grammar reused, causality survives the stack.
[CLAR-M2 missing funnel beat] 3-node capture waypoint at the arc apex (mini-panel + two faint field bars) — dots enter wide, dip behind it, exit aligned: the visual definition of a funnel. Budget 57 total, under 70.
[Low fixes adopted] LIVE rationale rewritten as 'system online' pulseDot language (broadcast-red claim removed); sheen baked to the 12s clock; mobile arc geometry specified; node arithmetic corrected everywhere (57); will-change dropped from dots (self-promoting compositor animations); border-radius 0 on fills / radius on tracks; backplane lines 2px at .25 opacity (no subpixel shimmer); WON lift window unified to 62–65%; radial-gradient halo replaces filter:blur; 'PIPELINE VALUE —' em-dash replaced with three ascending 4px block glyphs in #a39f99 (no null-state read, honesty intact).

Ambient: stage breathes on its 12s camera sine; ad card floats ±3px translateY. DECISIVE MOVE: at 0.72s the LIVE dot flares (scale 1→1.3→1, opacity to full, 6–9%, cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)) and the delivery fill surges scaleX(.5)→scaleX(.82) over 0.8s (8–14.7%, transform-origin left) — the site's growBar at hero scale, reading as 'next cycle begins'. The sheen makes its single 1.2s pass across the dark thumbnail at 4–14%. SPONSORED chip and headline bars static.

Ad card owns the front plane at translateZ(70px); funnel waypoint at translateZ(35px); pipeline board at translateZ(0); backplane grid at translateZ(-120px). transform-style: preserve-3d on stage and every wrapper.

Condensation is 3-to-1: dots 1–2 absorb into the empty NEW slot (scale 1→.6, fade to 0); dot 3's arrival triggers lead card A's fade-in at that exact position — a match cut, three signals became one lead. Dots 4–6 repeat for card B (A lands ~3.6s, B ~4.6s). Dots descend translateZ 70→0 as they travel, stitching the layers. Ad card eases translateZ 70→40px, ceding the front plane. Delivery bar holds; LIVE pulses on.
chapters.camera: No discrete camera move — the 12s sine continues (rotateY passing ~-6.8deg). The dots' physical z-descent (70→0px) renders as diagonal travel with true parallax against the -120px backplane under the rotated stage.
chapters.color: Dots ink #0d0d0d @70% opacity (on the inner leaf only) — deliberately not accent-colored; the only green this chapter is the still-pulsing LIVE dot. Waypoint: white→#eceae7 mini-panel, #e4e2de border, two field bars #a39f99 @40%. Board #f6f5f3 with #e4e2de border; headers NEW / QUALIFIED / WON in JetBrains Mono 11px uppercase +0.1em #55524d; dividers 1px #dedbd6; lead cards white→#eceae7 with solid #55524d tick bars.

chapters.name: ADVANCE — the pipeline flows
chapters.action: DECISIVE MOVE: one staggered cascade left-to-right — card A slides NEW→QUALIFIED (translateX one column width, 0.42s, cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)) at 42%, card A QUALIFIED→WON at 48%, card B NEW→QUALIFIED at 52%, -0.15s overlap rhythm. Header blinks are cut — arrival is carried by the cards physically landing. THE ONE EARNED ACCENT: card A's landing in WON is a compound arrival — the 6px green status dot ignites on the WON header at touchdown, and card A's tick bar does its growBar scaleX(.3→.9) 0.15s later. Value accrues as an abstract bar, no numbers. Upstream, LIVE keeps pulsing and the delivery bar holds — the engine is continuous.
chapters.camera: The sine climbs toward its peak lean (rotateX 13.2deg / rotateY -5.5deg at 62%) — the stage's one 'look closer' arrives exactly as the pipeline finishes and the handoff begins, with no discrete camera keyframe. Board at translateZ(0); ad card resting at 40px; nothing else moves in z.
chapters.color: Monochrome by design and now actually so: cards white→#eceae7, ticks #55524d, headers #55524d, hairlines #dedbd6. The single accent event is the WON compound arrival — green oklch(0.66 0.16 145) dose two. Restraint here makes chapter four's payoff earned.

chapters.name: ASCEND — the pipeline extrudes into the curve, then the shift change
chapters.action: DECISIVE MOVE (the client's payoff morph, now 4.55s): at 62–65% card A lifts translateZ(0→50px) and fades as the dark chart screen rises translateZ(40→90px) + opacity 0→1 behind it, its baseline aligned (computed at the 62% camera pose — the sine's stationary point) to continue the WON column's top edge: the pipeline extrudes upward. The curve is a STEPPED line whose three risers sit directly above NEW/QUALIFIED/WON — the pipeline's own silhouette climbing. Reveal 64.5–74.5% via the reveal-window (wrapper +w / inner SVG -w, both linear); the endpoint dot's X is linear and velocity-locked to the reveal edge, its Y easing up each riser; its pulseDot ring (radial-gradient, opacity-only pulse) breathes on the final riser. Label 'PIPELINE VALUE' + three ascending block glyphs — no fabricated number. FULLY DRAWN HOLD 74.5–95.5% (2.5s+): the image that sells, held. SEAM as designed shift change: 90–95% card B settle-fades in place (2px drop) with the WON dot; 92–100% ad card eases back to translateZ(70px); 95.5–99.5% chart + endpoint fade; 97–100% delivery fill opacity-swaps to its scaleX(.5) twin. LIVE never dims. Camera sine completes; frame 12.000s = frame 0.000s.
chapters.camera: The sine's return arc (rotateY -5.5→-8deg) is a gentle pull-back reading as 'step back and see what it built'. Chart panel owns the front plane at translateZ(90px) — the highest z in the piece, reserved for the payoff; overflow:hidden on the panel is safe because all its children are 2D.
chapters.color: Dark surface linear-gradient(150deg,#141414,#2b2a27) at hero scale, its only appearance; stepped curve stroke green oklch(0.66 0.16 145) at 2px with 8%-opacity area fill; endpoint = 6px green core + soft radial-gradient ring at <=.35 opacity (site pulseDot grammar, no bloom). Gridlines rgba(255,255,255,.07). Label + glyphs #a39f99 mono 11px. Everything else holds the chapter-one palette so the seam has nothing to snap.

spec.depth: One camera, one light, one breath. VIEWPORT: perspective: 1100px, perspective-origin 50% 42%, never animated. STAGE: base rotateX(12deg) rotateY(-8deg); a single 12s sine to rotateX(13.2deg) rotateY(-5.5deg) peaking at 62% and returning — max 13.2°/8°, inside the 22° cap; matched endpoints ARE the camera's loop seam, and the 62% stationary point doubles as the chart-alignment anchor (camera velocity ≈ 0 at the handoff). transform-style: preserve-3d on .stage and every wrapper down to each z-translated leaf; no 3D ancestor carries animated opacity, overflow, or filter (the board's opacity is static 1 for the whole loop; lead cards are stage siblings of the board). Z-LAYERS (5): backplane grid translateZ(-120px); pipeline board translateZ(0) — the narrative floor; funnel waypoint translateZ(35px), the mid-air capture plane the dots thread; ad card translateZ(70px) ceding to 40px after chapter one and easing home 92–100%; chart screen translateZ(90px) — the front plane is rationed, max z reserved for the payoff, only one element may hold it at a time. Dots travel 70→0px in z. LIGHT: implied upper-left, fixed — all shadows offset down-right: outer cards 18px 28px 60px -18px rgba(70,66,60,.38); chart screen 22px 34px 70px -16px rgba(70,66,60,.5); lead mini-cards 6px 10px 24px -8px rgba(70,66,60,.3); the sheen sweeps at 160deg agreeing with the same light, baked into the 12s clock (4–14%). Panel root overflow:hidden with all front-plane elements inset >=14px.

Camera holds the sine's 62% peak (rotateX 13.2deg / rotateY -5.5deg) — the most dimensional frame AND the exact pose the chart alignment was computed for, so the extrusion causality is pixel-perfect in the still. spec.logline: A live ad's reach funnels into leads, the leads flow left-to-right through a CRM pipeline, and the pipeline extrudes upward into its own stepped, climbing value curve — one continuous 12-second breath of a machine that is never off, proving Weakends builds money engines, not campaigns.
spec.loop: 12.0s total (chapters 2.4 / 2.4 / 2.65 / 4.55 — percentage bands 0–20 / 20–40 / 40–62 / 62–100). The seam is engineered four ways: (1) every animation is one 12s keyframe timeline with byte-identical 0%/100% frames — chapters are percentage bands, nothing chained, nothing (sheen included) off-clock; (2) the camera is one full sine, continuous through the cut; (3) the base state is RUNNING — LIVE lit and pulsing, delivery bar at scaleX(.5), board at full opacity — so no reset ever has to fake an ignition and no frame shows a dead machine; (4) the wind-down is a DESIGNED shift-change beat, not concealment: 90–95% card B and the WON dot settle-fade in place (2px drop, zero position change — position resets happen while invisible, since their 0% state is opacity 0), 92–100% the ad card eases back to translateZ(70px), 95.5–99.5% the chart and endpoint fade (their 0% state), 97–100% the delivery fill opacity-swaps to its identical solid scaleX(.5) twin. Frame 12.000s equals frame 0.000s exactly; the surge at 0.96s reads as the engine's next cycle — the loop IS the pitch: it never stops running.
spec.mobile: At 340×420 (content ~296×376): perspective 1300px, stage clamped to rotateX(8deg) rotateY(0) — near-planar so 11px labels stay legible — with the camera sine reduced to rotateX ±0.8deg only. Backplane grid DROPPED. Dots reduced 6→4 with 2-to-1 condensation (dots 1–2 → card A, 3–4 → card B — stated so the rhythm survives). spec.performance: Node budget (arithmetic verified): viewport/stage 2 + backplane 1 + ad card 12 + funnel waypoint 3 + dots 12 + pipeline board 8 + lead cards 4 + chart 14 + section label 1 = 57 nodes, under the 70 cap (mobile runs lighter: no backplane, 4 dots, 1 gridline ≈ 51). Every animated property is transform or opacity: the curve draws via the reveal-window counter-translate (no stroke-dashoffset, no gradient-mismatch cover), bars grow via scaleX with transform-origin left (radius 0 on fills, radius + overflow:hidden on tracks — safe, track subtrees are 2D), arcs and the endpoint's riser path are nested linear-X/eased-Y translates, all blinks/seams are opacity, and the halo is a radial-gradient background (no filter:blur layer; the static filter is gone entirely). preserve-3d discipline: declared on stage and every wrapper above a z-translated leaf; no 3D ancestor animates opacity/overflow/filter — the board holds opacity 1 for the whole loop and lead cards are stage siblings. will-change: transform,opacity ONLY on stage, 2 lead cards, chart panel, reveal wrapper + inner SVG, endpoint rig (~8 elements); dots get none — running compositor animations self-promote, and 12 permanently-held 8px layers cost more than on-demand promotion. Panel root overflow:hidden (declared; front-plane elements inset >=14px). FONTS: reuse the site's declared @font-face URLs (cache hit = usually zero swap) + font-display:swap + fixed px widths and line-heights on every label container (all strings are known constants) so any late swap repaints with zero layout shift. JS ~20 lines: IntersectionObserver (threshold .15) toggles .is-paused on the panel root; the CSS is `.is-paused, .is-paused * { animation-play-state: paused !important; }` — the !important is a deliberate state override that beats the animation shorthand's play-state reset regardless of source order, and the sheen is inside scope because it shares the 12s clock. prefers-reduced-motion is handled entirely in CSS via the media query (.is-still frame), no JS required.
spec.title: The Engine Room

motion_system.easing: Three shared families, plus a hard exemption rule. (1) HOUSE DECISIVE — cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), the site accordion curve: every decisive move, settle, dolly, entrance, cascade, growBar, and cut nudge in all three animations. (2) BREATH — cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1) (sinusoidal in-out): the ONLY curve for camera drift and ambient oscillation. Each panel's camera is one full sinusoid per 12s loop with zero velocity at 0%/100%, implemented as keyframed quarter-cycle segments (0/25/50/75/100%) using this bezier — lead already does exactly this; web's cosine and media's micro-drift/mic-float adopt the same segment implementation so all three cameras are literally the same code shape. (3) LINEAR — reveal wipes, velocity-locked movers (lead's reveal-window + endpoint X, media's playhead-adjacent counter-translates), and sheen translateX; anything that must stay velocity-matched to another element is linear by law. EXEMPTION RULE: each animation may carry AT MOST ONE documented bespoke curve, justified functionally, named in its spec, and never added at build time. Web: cubic-bezier(.5,.05,.3,1) on the RETURN flip only (widens backface reset windows — load-bearing math). Media: cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.3,1) on the playhead sweep only (symmetric in-out for a sweep). Lead: NONE — zero bespoke curves permitted.
motion_system.durations: One 12.000s master clock per panel; every story element is a single 12s keyframe set with byte-identical 0%/100% frames; chapters are percentage bands, never chained animations. Sub-clocks must be exact divisors of 12 (6s sheen, 2.4s ripple, 12s/6s mote floats) phased with NEGATIVE delays only. Shared duration ladder: taps/blinks/pulses 0.2s; settles and micro-moves 0.42s (the accordion heritage value — click ripples, growBar steps, cut nudges, tick blinks); decisive moves 0.8–1.2s (surges, flips, playhead-scale sweeps, card cascades read per-step at 0.42s); dollies/compound zooms 1.8–2.6s; payoff holds ≥1.8s of stable image before any seam fade; seam fades complete by 97% so the final ~0.36s is pure camera. Stagger quantum: 120ms and multiples (240ms for typing rhythm). Ambient floats fold into the 12s clock (one or two full cycles), replacing the site's loose 10–14s values — nothing free-runs except divisor sub-clocks. Site vocabulary mapping: growBar=0.42s house ease, pulseDot=opacity-only on the 12s clock, sheen=white ≤8% opacity traveling with the light (cadence per panel: 1–2 passes, always a divisor or in-clock band).
motion_system.depth: One camera grammar for all three. VIEWPORT: perspective 1100px desktop / 1300px mobile, perspective-origin 50% 42%, declared on a static wrapper, never animated. STAGE: transform-style: preserve-3d on the stage and EVERY wrapper between it and any z-translated leaf; no 3D ancestor may carry overflow (other than visible), filter, or animated opacity — all clipping lives in 2D leaf subtrees; elements that must escape a clipping/painting ancestor are stage SIBLINGS (web's flip card, lead's lead cards — this is the trio-wide pattern). ROTATION: rotateX positive 6–13.2° (elevated camera, always looking slightly down), rotateY within -8°…+4°; camera drift amplitude ≤4° on the breath sinusoid with zero velocity at the seam; composed camera+object rotation never exceeds 22°; mobile clamps to rotateX 6–8°, rotateY 0 or near-0 (near-planar so 11px mono renders flat). Z-LADDER (shared convention): BACK -120px (backplanes, dust, vignettes — web's dust moves from -140 to -120); SHADOW/MID-BACK -90…-40px (ground shadows, bezels, chrome, tiles); MID 0px (the protagonist/narrative floor); MID-FRONT +30…+70px (floaters, phones, HUD chips, ad card); TOP +90px maximum (payoff plane / cursor), rationed — one element holds it at a time. LIGHT: single implied source upper-left (~315°), fixed across all three; every shadow offsets down-right in rgba(70,66,60, .3–.5), pre-painted and animated only by opacity crossfade between static twins; total downward shadow extent capped inside the panel padding (web's rule, now trio law) so nothing clips at the 22px radius or the 4:3 crop.
motion_system.color: Neutrals are byte-identical across all three panels: ground #f1f0ee; panel/site gradient linear-gradient(160deg,#ffffff,#eceae7); dark surface linear-gradient(150deg,#141414,#2b2a27) (every screen, bezel, thumbnail); ink #0d0d0d; greys #55524d/#8b8781/#a39f99; hairlines #dedbd6/#e4e2de; inner cards #f6f5f3; shadows rgba(70,66,60,.3–.5). ACCENT ASSIGNMENT (one family each, no overlap, semantic): WEB = purple oklch(0.62 0.19 305) — the craft/build accent (caret, compile flash, click ripple, status dot). MEDIA = ember oklch(0.62 0.19 40) — the live-voice/recording accent (REC dot, playhead, arrival ticks). LEAD = green oklch(0.66 0.16 145) — the money/growth accent (LIVE dot, WON dot, value curve). Green and purple never appear in media; ember and green never in web; purple and ember never in lead. SHARED ACCENT RULES: (a) each loop OPENS with its accent as a single small lit point (purple caret / ember REC dot / green LIVE dot) — the trio's signature; (b) ≤6 painted accent marks per loop; (c) never two accent objects at full strength simultaneously — persistent accents dim (to ~0.25) during handoffs — EXCEPT that the accent family may compound in the final payoff chapter only (lead's curve+endpoint crescendo); (d) the seam frame carries at most one DIM accent point, never a full-strength one; (e) accents are opacity/scale-animated only — no animated color, no filter glows; all glows are static pre-painted radial-gradients or box-shadows on opacity-animated elements.
motion_system.type: Inside panels, everything is JetBrains Mono: 11px, uppercase, +0.1em tracking, baseline ink #8b8781 — 11px is now the trio floor for ALL panel labels (lead already there; media's MANAGED/PUBLISHED/REC chips and web's BUILD/SHIP label rise from 10 to 11px). Load-bearing labels (column headers, anything the story cannot be read without) step down to #55524d, never bolder type. Schibsted Grotesk does NOT appear inside any of the three panels — display type is page-level only. Every text-bearing chip/label sits in a fixed px width + fixed line-height box with centered text (strings are known constants) so a font swap can never shift diorama geometry. Text rendered under the camera transform at magnified poses uses the counter-scale authoring trick (author at pose scale inside a static inverse-scale wrapper) so mono rasterizes native-crisp. No glyph-based shapes anywhere — bars, dashes, and dots are divs/pseudo-elements; the em-dash appears only as literal redaction text inside labels (REC · SESSION —). Honest data only: '—', abstract bars, block glyphs — no numerals pretending to be metrics.
